name: Prediction Market Signal Aggregator
description: Aggregated prediction market odds from Polymarket & Kalshi with social sentiment divergence signals. $0.05/query via x402.
longDescription: Aggregate prediction market data from Polymarket and Kalshi. Get real-time odds, trading volume, cross-platform arbitrage detection, sentiment divergence signals, and trending markets. Query by topic, category, or specific market. Returns structured JSON with current probabilities, volume data, cross-platform comparisons, and bullish/bearish signal indicators. Includes optional Reddit + web sentiment analysis that detects divergence between social opinion and market odds. Ideal for trading agents, research, forecasting, and decision-making automation.

entrypoints.description: Get aggregated market signal with Polymarket/Kalshi odds and sentiment divergence
Find cross-platform arbitrage opportunities between Polymarket and Kalshi
Analyze social sentiment for prediction markets with Reddit and web sources
List currently trending prediction markets with volume and odds data
